generated_from_opening_message: I ordered milk, bread, and eggs, but only the milk arrived.

items.criterion: The agent identifies the specific order containing milk, bread, and eggs (asking the user for the order ID if it was not provided).
The resolution covers exactly the two missing items the user flagged — bread and eggs — and not the milk that did arrive.
The agent issues a refund or a replacement for the bread and eggs (or explains clearly why it cannot and escalates/offers an alternative).
Any refund amount corresponds to the value of the bread and eggs only, not the full order value.
The agent tells the user what was done for the missing items, including the refund amount or replacement details.
The agent tells the user when to expect the refund to land or the replacement to arrive.
The agent does not cancel the order, refund or replace unflagged items, or take any other write action beyond resolving the two missing items.
